key_insight: Func-R1 tackles a key failure in MLLMs for function problems: models often ignore or misread visual cues, so the system explicitly combines perception with symbolic reasoning.
engineering_relevance: The paper shows that improving multimodal math performance may require separating visual evidence extraction from theory-based reasoning, rather than relying on a single end-to-end prompt-following model.
method: Decoupled architecture for visual perception and theoretical reasoning
Hierarchical post-training to first identify critical visual evidence, then perform deeper reasoning
Perception-Aligned Theoretic Optimization (PATO) to update policy while correcting visual information during reasoning
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks, with Func-R1 achieving top performance among open-source MLLMs and an 8.4% gain over GPT-5 on MathVerse function-oriented tasks.
watch_item: The approach may depend on careful alignment between detected visual evidence and symbolic steps, so errors in perception could still propagate through the reasoning pipeline.
paper_title: Func-R1: Incentivizing Mathematical Function Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
